text:
Dana R.: Quick sync: we need a short partner-ready runbook for the LangChain <-> Gateway adapter and a marketplace listing that clearly states recommended infra and the trial SKU. Target: partner preview next Tue.
Luis M.: TL;DR: partner preview ok if we have (1) sample deploy manifest, (2) perf notes for H100/A100, (3) legal co-mark copy, (4) telemetry map.
Hannah (Eng): Working on a minimal manifest and a fallback policy. Sample below:
```
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: lc-gateway-adapter-demo
spec:
  replicas: 1
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: adapter
        image: redwood/gateway-adapter:partner-preview
        resources:
          limits:
            nvidia.com/gpu: 1
        env:
        - name: MODE
          value: "demo"
```
Amit (SI): Good. SI needs a deterministic quota note: "reserve 2 GPUs for rehearsal + 1 for live". Also request a small checklist for ops: auth, metrics, fallbacks.
Todd (Marketplace): SKU constraints: <=60 chars, no special chars except hyphen. Proposed: "Gateway-Adapter-LangChain-Partner-Beta-[partner:BetaCo]". We'll put listing in draft partner-only.
Elena (Legal): I'll generate co-mark copy. Reminder: if partner logo includes a trademark, we need a signed co-mark form. ETA: 36h.
ops-bot: Note: scheduled infra maintenance Wed 02:00-03:00 UTC. Avoid demo pushes during that window.
Dana R.: Perf callout: Victor (HW) asked us to say: "H100 shows ~1.8x tokens/sec vs A100 at INT8 quantized profile; latency varies by prompt length." We'll include sanitized numbers.
Hannah (Eng): We'll also expose /metrics Prometheus endpoint and a metrics map: adapter.requests_total, adapter.latency_ms, adapter.batch_size. SI requested that naming to avoid collisions.
Amit (SI): Can we get a short rollback plan if quota drops mid-demo? Example: route to cpu_quantized model variant.
Hannah (Eng): Yes, policy chain example:
```
routing:
  - policy: prefer_gpu
    fallback: cpu_quantized
```
Dana R.: Marketing needs two one-line partner blurbs for the landing page and a hero image PNG (partner-friendly). Todd, can you gate the marketplace preview until assets arrive?
Todd (Marketplace): Yes. I'll hold listing in partner-drafts/313579 until we get assets and legal approval.
Elena (Legal): Sending co-mark draft to BetaCo PM now. Please confirm logo formats (SVG preferred).
beta-partner: We'll provide SVG + 2 PNG variants by EOD Mon. Confirming we can use "in collaboration with" phrasing.
Dana R.: That phrasing is fine. Proposed timeline: dry-run Fri 2024-05-10, partner rehearsal Mon 2024-05-13, partner preview Tue 2024-05-14, public beta Thu 2024-05-16. Any blockers?
Luis M.: Ops maintenance on Wed ok. Legal ETA could be a blocker — Elena, flag if delayed.
Elena (Legal): If co-mark not returned by Tue EOD, push partner preview one week.
Dana R.: Action items recap:
- Hannah: publish manifest + metrics map + fallback example
- Elena: co-mark copy + request form
- Todd: create partner-draft SKU and hold listing
- Amit: confirm SI rehearsal availability + test checklist
- Beta-partner: provide SVG/PNG assets
Dana R.: If all clear, Ill post final runbook link and tag owners. Any final notes?
Hannah (Eng): I'll add a small smoke test script to the runbook and link CI logs.
Amit (SI): We'll plan a 30-min arch sync after manifest posted.
Todd (Marketplace): I'll prepare marketplace blurb templates for review.
Dana R.: Thanks — locking dates provisionally. End thread.
